scored_objects.label: π
scored_objects.notes: Transcendental, irrational, appears in geometry/probability/quantum/number theory. No algebraic anchor.

scored_objects.label: Riemann Hypothesis (open)
scored_objects.notes: 160+ years open. Connects prime distribution, quantum chaos, RMT, cryptography. No resolution mechanism.

scored_objects.label: P vs NP (open)
scored_objects.notes: Touches every computational domain. Resistance to all approaches suggests constitutive inaccessibility.

scored_objects.label: e (Euler's number)
scored_objects.notes: Transcendental, universal. Slight α reduction: self-referential (d/dx e^x = e^x) — partial anchor to its own structure.

scored_objects.label: γ (Euler-Mascheroni)
scored_objects.notes: Unknown if rational or irrational — maximally opaque. Less universal than π/e. No algebraic anchor.

scored_objects.label: FLT before 1995 (open)
scored_objects.notes: 358 years open. Connected elliptic curves, modular forms. No resolution mechanism before Wiles.

scored_objects.label: Poincaré Conjecture before 2003 (open)
scored_objects.notes: 98 years open. 3-manifold topology. Multiple failed proof attempts.

scored_objects.label: Navier-Stokes Existence (open)
scored_objects.notes: Millennium Problem. Connects fluid dynamics, turbulence theory, PDE theory. Some structural knowledge (weak solutions).

scored_objects.label: Collatz Conjecture (open)
scored_objects.notes: Elementary statement, zero known structure. Medium R: narrow coupling — few domain connections despite depth.

scored_objects.label: Four Color Theorem before 1976 (open)
scored_objects.notes: 124 years open. Graph theory domain. Moderate domain coupling.

scored_objects.label: φ (golden ratio)
scored_objects.notes: Algebraic (root of x²-x-1=0). Appears in geometry, biology, art. Algebraic anchor present.

scored_objects.label: Goldbach Conjecture (open)
scored_objects.notes: Open, but partial results (Chen's theorem) give slight O reduction. Narrow coupling to number theory only.

scored_objects.label: Gödel Incompleteness
scored_objects.notes: Constitutively inaccessible. Universal — appears in all sufficiently powerful formal systems. α=0: formally independent of any axiom system. Cannot define external reference.

scored_objects.label: Russell's Paradox
scored_objects.notes: Destroys naive set theory from inside — D3 endpoint. One-time Pe spike → system collapse → resolution forced. α=1: partially anchored to its destruction of naive set theory.

scored_objects.label: √2
scored_objects.notes: Algebraic irrational (root of x²-2=0). Interior accessible via polynomial. Narrow domain coupling.

scored_objects.label: Banach-Tarski Paradox
scored_objects.notes: Counterintuitive result within ZFC. Not paradoxical given axiom of choice — O partially reduced. Narrow domain.

scored_objects.label: Continuum Hypothesis
scored_objects.notes: Independent of ZFC (Cohen 1963, Gödel 1940). α=0 by construction: no axiom system resolves it — different valid choices. Less universal than Gödel.

scored_objects.label: Four Color Theorem after 1976 (solved, computer-assisted)
scored_objects.notes: PARTIAL PROOF EVENT: Computer-assisted proof — mechanism known but not humanly verifiable. O partially reduced (not fully collapsed).

scored_objects.label: FLT after 1995 (solved)
scored_objects.notes: PROOF EVENT: O collapses (mechanism transparent via modularity). R preserved (elliptic curve domain still active). α reduced.

scored_objects.label: Poincaré Conjecture after 2003 (solved)
scored_objects.notes: PROOF EVENT: Perelman's Ricci flow proof. O collapses. Pe expected to drop sharply.

scored_objects.label: 1/3 (rational)
scored_objects.notes: CONTROL: Rational. Transparent interior (= 0.333..., fully known). Narrow coupling, anchored.

scored_objects.label: 0 (additive identity)
scored_objects.notes: CONSTRAINT POLE CONTROL: Fully transparent. Additive identity — no opacity, no independent coupling.

M3_META_REGIME.key_finding: alpha=0 INCREASES c (less coupling in sum), which DECREASES Pe. High alpha = compounding engagement = lower c = higher Pe. CH is constraint-dominant (Pe<0): independence result terminates engagement. This correctly predicts why CH generates less obsessive engagement than RH.

M5_ALPHA_SWEEP.key_finding: Pe strictly increases with alpha. At alpha=0 (no compounding): ANCIENT/STABLE. At alpha=3 (maximum compounding): FISHER_RUNAWAY. The alpha dimension controls how void-forming an epistemic object is via coupling.

falsifiable_predictions.text: Publication rate adjacent to Riemann Hypothesis follows Langevin rise curve (θ=0.28→1 over decades, never resolving).
Citation half-life: solved-problem papers (FLT post-1995, Poincaré post-2003) decay faster than open-problem papers. Pe collapse = engagement collapse.
Career specialization depth: mathematicians on open Millennium Problems have higher career-concentration than those on since-solved problems.

Gödel/CH papers show LOWER per-paper citation engagement than Riemann papers. Gödel Pe=3.84 (ANCIENT/STABLE), CH Pe<0 (CONSTRAINT). α=0 means the result terminates the chain — no compounding, no follow-on spawning. Riemann α=3: every paper opens three new directions. Pe correctly predicts the engagement differential.
